cases.situation: I sell handmade ceramic mugs on Etsy. A customer just DM'd me a photo of a mug that arrived cracked.
cases.reply: Oh no, I'm so sorry, that's not how it should have arrived. Could you send one more photo of the box? Then I'll ship a replacement tomorrow, no need to send the broken one back. If you'd rather have a refund, just say and it's done.
cases.note: Never make them return a broken item first; the photo is enough.

cases.situation: We print packaging for a cosmetics brand. Their 5,000 boxes will be 10 days late because our foil supplier is behind. Contact is Lena, their launch is Nov 20.
cases.reply: Hi Lena, PO 8812 (5,000 printed boxes) will now reach you on 6 November instead of 27 October, because our foil supplier is behind. That still leaves two weeks before your launch on the 20th. If that's too tight for your filling schedule, I can send 2,000 unfoiled boxes on 27 October at no charge so your line can start, with the full foiled order on the 6th. Let me know by Friday which you'd prefer and I'll confirm the dates in writing the same day. Marco
cases.note: B2B customers need a plan they can pass on, so lead with the date and the launch buffer.

cases.situation: Ich habe einen kleinen Online-Teeshop. Eine Kundin, Frau Krüger, hat die Sorte Winterapfel bestellt (Bestellung 3087), die ist aber ausverkauft. Neue Lieferung kommt am 20. Oktober.
cases.reply: Hallo Frau Krüger, der Winterapfel aus Ihrer Bestellung 3087 ist ausverkauft, das hätte unser Shop gar nicht mehr annehmen dürfen. Die neue Lieferung kommt am 20. Oktober, und Ihr Paket geht am selben Tag raus. Drei Möglichkeiten: Sie warten, und ich lege eine Probe unserer neuen Rooibos-Mischung dazu; Sie nehmen stattdessen den Bratapfel, der morgen verschickt wird; oder Sie bekommen heute die volle Erstattung. Wenn ich bis Freitag nichts höre, halte ich die Bestellung für den 20. fest. Entschuldigen Sie die Umstände. Viele Grüße, Jana
cases.note: State the default so doing nothing is also a clear choice.

cases.situation: 我在淘宝卖手工香薰蜡烛。顾客林女士的订单（尾号5816）顺丰物流9月22号之后就没更新了，今天快递确认丢件。她是买来送朋友10月3号生日的，还没来问。
cases.reply: 林女士您好，您的订单（尾号5816）出了问题：顺丰今天确认包裹在中转站丢失了，我们刚查到，先跟您说一声。我今天下午给您重新发一份，走顺丰特快，10月1日前送到，赶得上您朋友3号的生日。如果您更想退款，回我“退款”两个字，我当天原路退回。今晚之前没收到回复的话，我就按重发处理，单号发您；原来那份如果后来到了，您留着就好。给您添麻烦了。店主小周
cases.note: Proactive, before she has to ask: the fix is built around her gift date, refund is one word, and the default is stated.

cases.situation: I make custom oak dining tables. Customer Marcus was promised Oct 2 after I already pushed it once from Sept 18. Now the tabletop finish needs redoing and it'll be Oct 16. He's hosting family on the 17th.
cases.reply: Hi Marcus, your table won't make 2 October, and I know this is the second time I've moved it. The finish on the top didn't cure evenly and I'm redoing it. It will be delivered on Friday 16 October, a date I'm certain of, the day before your family arrives. I've refunded the $150 delivery fee today. If you'd rather not wait, I'll refund the whole order instead; if I don't hear back, the 16th stands. I'll send you photos of the finished top on Monday 12 October. Tom
cases.note: On a second slip, refund something unasked and give only a date you are sure you can keep.

cases.situation: I make a small-batch card game. 312 people preordered for early October delivery. The factory just told me the print run failed quality check and needs reprinting, so shipping moves to around Nov 13. Need to email everyone.
cases.reply:
Subject: Your Night Market preorder now ships around November 13
Hi everyone,
Your Night Market preorder is delayed: it will ship around November 13 instead of early October. The first print run failed our quality check (the colours came out muddy), and I'd rather reprint than send a game I'm not proud of. You can wait and get tracking the day it ships, swap to Harbour Lights, which is in stock and ships this week, or reply 'refund' for your full $34 within two days. If I don't hear from you, your order stays as it is. Every order will include the promo expansion as a thank-you. I'll email again on October 30 with a firm date.
Maya, Lanternfly Games
cases.note: A mass email to many buyers: the delay in the subject line, one line of reason, three options and a default, so nobody has to reply.

cases.situation: Customer Dana ordered a linen dress (#6203) on Sept 14 for a trip this Saturday. I emailed yesterday that it's delayed to Oct 5 because the fabric is late. She replied: 'This is ridiculous, I ordered it specifically for my trip. Terrible service.' The sage colour is in stock.
cases.reply: Understood, Dana, and I'm sorry: you ordered it for the trip and we've let you down. The sage version is in stock, and if you'd like it I'll send it by express today so it reaches you by Friday 2 October. Otherwise the original ships Monday 5 October, or say the word and I'll refund the full $128 today. I'll check in tomorrow morning either way.
cases.note: Don't re-explain the delay to an angry customer; give the one option that still fixes her real problem, a firm date, and the refund again.

cases.situation: I sell leather wallets on my own Shopify site. Customer Ben emailed: tracking says order #2194 was delivered Friday but he never got it. Nothing on the doorstep, neighbours haven't seen it. It was $85.
cases.reply:
Hi Ben, I'm sorry, that's frustrating after watching the tracking. Tracking shows order #2194 delivered on Friday 25 September, so I've opened a claim with the courier this morning and asked for the GPS drop point. Could you check once with your building manager or mailroom? If it hasn't turned up by Thursday 1 October, I'll send a replacement by express that day, and if the first one appears you keep both. Or say 'refund' and I'll refund the $85 today. I'll email you Thursday either way.
Leah
cases.note: 'Delivered but not received' is still yours to fix: one reasonable check for him, a claim for you, a firm date for the replacement and refund as an easy exit.

cases.situation: 我开网店卖儿童绘本。顾客张先生订了三本（订单尾号3392），其中《小熊的秋天》出版社缺货，要10月20日才到货，另外两本是现货。他还不知道。
cases.reply: 张先生您好，您的订单（尾号3392）里有一本出了问题：《小熊的秋天》出版社缺货，10月20日到货，是我们没及时下架。另外两本现货，明天就能发。三种方式您选：1是先发两本，《小熊的秋天》20日到货当天单独补寄，运费我们出；2是三本等到20日一起发；3是这本直接退款，今天原路退回。您不回复的话，我就按第1种先发两本。有问题随时找我。店主阿宁
cases.note: 部分缺货：先说哪本、哪天到，再给三个选择和默认选项；分开寄的运费由店家承担。

cases.situation: I sell knitwear online. Customer Hannah ordered a navy wool scarf (#5532) as a birthday gift for Saturday, and I sent the grey one by mistake. She emailed me a photo this morning.
cases.reply:
Hi Hannah, you're right, order #5532 should have been the navy scarf and I sent grey, that's my mistake. The navy one goes out today by express and will be with you by Thursday 1 October, in time for Saturday. Keep the grey one, no need to send it back. If you'd rather have a full refund instead, just say and I'll process it today. I'll email you tracking by 5pm.
Maya
cases.note: Your mistake: own it in one line, fix it before the deadline that matters to them, and let the make-good (keep the wrong one) do the apologising.

cases.situation: I sell handmade leather bags from the UK. Customer Chris in Toronto, order #3308, is stuck in Canadian customs, and they want him to pay $38 CAD in duties that my checkout never mentioned. He hasn't messaged me yet.
cases.reply:
Hi Chris,
Your order #3308 has reached Canada but is being held at customs, and they're asking for $38 CAD in import duties before releasing it. That's on me: the checkout should have warned you and it didn't. If you pay through the courier's link in their email and send me the receipt, I'll refund the $38 the same day. If you'd rather not, reply 'cancel' and I'll refund the whole order today. I'll check the tracking on Thursday and email you then either way.
Laura
cases.note: Proactive, owns the missing warning, and the make-good covers the surprise fee; refund stays the easiest option to pick.

cases.situation: I make engraved name necklaces on my own. I sprained my wrist on Saturday and can't engrave until Monday Oct 12. Customer Olivia ordered #1187 ($68) for her mum's birthday on Friday Oct 9, and I promised dispatch on Oct 1.
cases.reply:
Hi Olivia, your order #1187 (the engraved name necklace) won't reach you before your mum's birthday on Friday 9 October, and I'm sorry. I sprained my wrist on Saturday and can't engrave until Monday 12 October; it would ship that day by express and arrive by Wednesday the 14th. Three options: wait, and I'll email you a printable card with a photo of her necklace today so you have something to give her on the 9th; swap for the unengraved birthstone pendant, which ships tomorrow and arrives in time; or a full refund of the $68 today. If I don't hear back by Thursday, I'll keep your order for the 12th. I'll email you tracking the day it ships.
Nina
cases.note: When the deadline can't be met, say so first, give the personal reason in one plain line, and build the options around her real date.

cases.situation: Tenho uma florista em Lisboa. A noiva, Inês, encomendou um bouquet de peónias brancas para o casamento no sábado, 10 de outubro, e já pagou 180 €. O fornecedor acabou de avisar que não há peónias, a época já passou.
cases.reply:
Olá Inês, tenho uma má notícia sobre o seu bouquet de 10 de outubro: o fornecedor confirmou hoje que não há peónias brancas, a época delas já terminou. A data do casamento não muda, por isso proponho duas alternativas com o mesmo ar romântico: rosas de jardim brancas com lisianthus, ou dálias cor de marfim. Envio-lhe fotos das duas até amanhã às 12h. Se a opção que escolher ficar mais barata, devolvo a diferença, e se preferir cancelar, reembolso os 180 € na totalidade. Se não tiver notícias suas até segunda, dia 5, avanço com as rosas de jardim. Peço desculpa por não ter confirmado isto mais cedo.
Marta
cases.note: Quando esperar não é opção, as escolhas passam a ser substituir ou reembolsar, com fotos para decidir e uma opção por defeito.

cases.situation: 我开网店卖茶具。顾客吴女士订的一套青瓷茶具（订单尾号7721），收货地址填成了她以前住的小区，快递员电话也没打通，包裹正在退回，预计10月6号回到我这。她还不知道。
cases.reply: 吴女士您好，您的订单（尾号7721）遇到点问题：收货地址是您以前的小区翠湖花园，快递员联系不上您，包裹正在退回我这边，预计10月6日到。您把现在的地址发我，包裹一回来我当天重新寄出，这次运费我们出。如果不想再等，回我“退款”，我今天就全额原路退回。收到您的新地址之前，包裹我先留在店里，不会再寄。店主小林
cases.note: 就算是顾客填错了地址，也不追究是谁的错：说清事实、新日期和选项，默认做法写明白，补一次运费是小小的善意。

cases.situation: 我做手工皮具。顾客陈先生订了一个刻字钱包（订单尾号2046），直接寄到杭州他父亲家，作为10月5日的生日惊喜。皮料供应商延迟了，最早10月9日才能发货，我只能联系陈先生，不能让老人知道。
cases.reply: 陈先生您好，您给父亲订的刻字钱包（订单尾号2046）赶不上10月5日的生日了，先跟您说一声。原因是酒红色皮料供应商延迟到货，最早10月9日刻好发出，顺丰预计10月11日前送到。三种选择：一是等到10月9日发货，运费升级为加急，我来出；二是换成现货的深棕色款，刻同样的字，明天发出，预计10月3日前送到；三是全额退款，今天原路退回。周五（10月2日）前没收到您的回复，我就按第一种处理。所有消息我只发给您，不会联系您父亲。给您添麻烦了。店主阿杰
cases.note: 礼物直接寄给收件人时，只和下单人沟通，并说明不会惊动收礼的人；选项围绕他真正在意的生日来设计。

cases.situation: 農家で新米のネット販売をしています。佐藤様から新米コシヒカリ5kg（注文番号1042）を10月5日発送でご注文いただいていますが、長雨で稲刈りが遅れ、発送は10月16日になります。昨年産のコシヒカリなら在庫があり、5kgで600円安いです。
cases.reply:
佐藤様
ご注文の新米コシヒカリ5kg（注文番号1042）について、長雨で稲刈りが遅れ、10月5日のお約束だった発送が10月16日（金）になります。お待ちいただける場合は、16日に発送し、当日に追跡番号をお知らせします。すぐにお米が必要でしたら、在庫のある昨年産コシヒカリ5kgを明日発送し、差額の600円をお返しします。全額返金をご希望でしたら、本日中に手続きいたします。10月2日（金）までにご返信がなければ、16日の発送でお待ちいただく形で進めます。お待たせして申し訳ありません。
山田農園　山田
cases.note: 天候による遅れでも、新しい日付、三つの選択肢、返信がない場合の扱いを一度に伝える。

cases.situation: I run a small online yarn shop. Grace ordered 8 skeins of the Moss colourway (order #7710, $22 each, $176 total) for a sweater, but I only have 5, and the dyer has just told me Moss is discontinued. Fern is a similar green and I have 12 skeins in stock at the same price; I'll hold her order until Monday Oct 5. I'm Mia.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, I can't fill your order #7710 for 8 skeins of Moss: I have 5 left, and the dyer has just told me Moss is discontinued, so no more are coming. Your options: swap all 8 for Fern, a similar green I have in stock at the same price; take the 5 Moss and a $66 refund for the other 3; or a full refund of $176. I'll hold your order until Monday 5 October, and if I haven't heard from you by then I'll refund it in full. Just reply with the one you'd like. Mia
cases.note: When the item is never coming back, drop the wait option and make the full refund the default.

cases.situation: I make wooden baby teething rings. In my final check I found hairline cracks in several rings from the current batch, so I'm holding the whole batch; the new one is ready Wednesday Oct 21. Customer Aisha's order #3319 ($24) hasn't shipped. The maple rattle is from a different batch, passed its check and could ship tomorrow, and I'm happy to add free express. I'm Theo.
cases.reply: Hi Aisha, your order #3319, the maple teething ring, won't ship this week. In my final check I found hairline cracks in several rings from this batch, and I won't send anything meant for a baby's mouth unless I'm sure of it, so I'm holding the whole batch. The new batch is ready on Wednesday 21 October and yours ships that day. Three options: wait, and I'll add free express shipping; swap for the maple rattle, which is from a different batch, passed its check and ships tomorrow; or a full refund of $24 today. If I don't hear back by Monday 5 October, I'll hold your order for the 21st. Theo
cases.note: A quality hold on a baby product is a reason to state plainly in one line, never a date to rush.

cases.situation: 我是小周，在小区微信群做水果团购，42户订了阳光玫瑰葡萄，原定10月2日周五到货。果园刚通知连续下雨推迟采摘，改到10月6日周二到。现在有巨峰葡萄现货，价格一样，明天就能取；要退款的我当天原路退。
cases.reply: 各位邻居好，我是团购的小周。大家订的阳光玫瑰葡萄要晚几天：原定10月2日（周五）到货，果园那边连续下雨，采摘推迟，改为10月6日（周二）到，到货当天我在群里通知取货。不想等的有两个选择：换成现货的巨峰葡萄，价格一样，明天就能取；或者私信我“退款”，当天原路退回。今晚12点前没私信我的，就默认等6号的阳光玫瑰。给大家添麻烦了，谢谢理解。
cases.note: Group-buy chats: one message to everyone, options by private message, so the group doesn't turn into a complaint thread.

cases.situation: I'm Elif and I sell vintage lamps on my own site and on a marketplace. Last night the green 1960s glass lamp sold on both within an hour; the marketplace buyer paid first, so Hugo's order #5120 ($145) on my site can't be filled. I have a similar amber lamp from the same era at $135, and a green one listed at $160 that I'm happy to let him have for $145.
cases.reply:
Hi Hugo, I can't send the green 1960s glass lamp from your order #5120: it sold on another site shortly before you ordered, and as it's one of a kind there isn't another coming. That's my mistake, my listings didn't sync in time. Your options: a full refund of $145, processed today; the amber lamp from the same era at $135, with the $10 difference refunded; or the green lamp listed at $160, for the same $145. Photos of both are attached. If I don't hear from you by Friday 2 October, I'll refund you in full.
Elif
cases.note: A one-of-a-kind item has no wait option: refund is the default, and the alternatives come with photos.

cases.situation: 我在网上卖手工羊毛围巾，120条预售原定10月15日前发货。织工阿姨生病请了两周假，最快10月29日（周四）全部发完。想群发给买家，愿意等的照常发，不想等的全额退款。
cases.reply: 您好，您在我们店预订的手工羊毛围巾，原定10月15日前发货，现在要晚两周：负责织围巾的阿姨生病请了两周假，最快10月29日（周四）能全部发出。想问问您愿不愿意等到那天？如果不方便等，直接回复我，马上给您全额退款。给您添麻烦了，谢谢理解。
cases.note: 一对多的延期：早说、给具体日期、把退款作为真正的选择，而不是让买家来要。

cases.situation: I'm Priya and I run a small coffee subscription: 140 subscribers were charged $24 on Oct 1 for the October box, due to ship Monday Oct 5. Our roaster's machine broke down, so the boxes will now ship Monday Oct 12. Anyone who'd rather skip October gets a full refund, and I need to email everyone today.
cases.reply:
Subject: Your October box now ships Monday 12 October
Hi there, your October coffee box will ship on Monday 12 October instead of Monday 5 October, because our roaster's machine broke down this week. If you're happy to wait, you don't need to do anything: it ships on the 12th and I'll send tracking the same day. If you'd rather skip October, just reply 'skip' and I'll refund your $24 in full that day. I'll be in touch again on the 12th when the boxes go out.
Priya
cases.note: Subscribers have already paid, so the refund has to be a one-word reply, and doing nothing means waiting.

cases.situation: 我开家具店。顾客陈先生的三人沙发（订单尾号6630）原定10月9日（周五）上午送货安装，他说那天特意请了假。我们的送装车队排期出了错，最早只能10月10日（周六）上午，或者10月12日（周一）以后他挑一天。是我们的问题，想免掉他200元送装费。我是客服小吴。
cases.reply: 陈先生您好，您的三人沙发（订单尾号6630）原定10月9日（周五）上午送装，我们这边排不上了，是我们车队排期出了错，先跟您说一声。我知道您那天特意请了假，真的很抱歉。现在可以改到10月10日（周六）上午，或者10月12日（周一）以后您挑任意一天；如果不想再等，也可以全额退款，当天原路退回。这次的200元送装费我们免掉。10月7日前没收到您回复的话，我就先给您留着10日上午。客服小吴
cases.note: 上门送装的延误，代价是客户为此请的假：先认这一点，再给新日期、退款和默认安排。

cases.situation: I'm Ruth and I run a small plant nursery. Mr Patel ordered three bare-root apple trees (order 0412, £135) for delivery on Saturday 3 October, but our grower has pushed them to Saturday 17 October. He doesn't use email, so I'm leaving a voicemail; I can deliver three potted apple trees this Saturday at no extra cost instead, and my number is 01632 960472.
cases.reply: Hello Mr Patel, it's Ruth from the nursery, about your order 0412, the three apple trees. They won't make Saturday 3 October: our grower has moved the bare-root trees to Saturday 17 October, and we'd deliver yours that day. If you'd rather not wait, I can bring three potted apple trees this Saturday at no extra cost, or refund your £135 in full. If I don't hear from you, I'll keep your order for the 17th. My number is 01632 960472, again, 01632 960472. I'll ring you on Monday either way.
cases.note: On a voicemail, lead with who you are and which order, keep the options short, and say the number twice.

cases.situation: 我是做海鲜批发的老周。望江楼的王师傅订了30公斤冰鲜三文鱼（单号A0927），10月3日（周六）早上送到，做婚宴用。进口航班取消，周六只能到18公斤，剩下12公斤要10月5日（周一）才到。三文鱼一公斤150元，我有现货冰鲜鲈鱼可以补，一公斤60元。
cases.reply: 王师傅，您单号A0927的30公斤三文鱼出了问题，先跟您说一声：进口航班取消了，周六（10月3日）早上只能送到18公斤，剩下12公斤要10月5日（周一）才到，赶不上婚宴。周六早上的18公斤照常送。差的12公斤您看：一是换成现货冰鲜鲈鱼12公斤，周六一起送到，720元，差价1080元退给您；二是这12公斤不要了，1800元当天退给您。麻烦您明天（10月2日）中午12点前定一下，到时候没收到消息，我先按鲈鱼备货，再打电话跟您确认。老周
cases.note: B2B客户最关心的是自己的出菜计划：先给能确定到的量，再给救急的替代、退款和明确的决定时间。

cases.situation: I'm Owen and I make handmade chocolates. A gift box (order #2871) bought by a customer called Laura for her friend Ruth arrived melted after sitting in a hot depot over the weekend, and Ruth, not Laura, has just emailed me a photo. I can send a new box in an insulated pack tomorrow to arrive Monday 5 October, and I don't want to spoil the surprise for Laura or make Ruth deal with a refund.
cases.reply: Hi Ruth, thank you for letting me know, and I'm sorry, that's not how Laura's gift should have reached you. The box sat in a hot depot over the weekend and the chocolates didn't survive it. I'll send a fresh box tomorrow in an insulated pack, arriving Monday 5 October, and there's no need to send the melted one back. I'll let Laura know it's been sorted so she doesn't hear about it any other way. Owen
cases.note: When the recipient reports the problem, fix it with them directly and keep money questions for the buyer.
